_comment: 10 Player Powers (Upgrade Pack). Coloured = matches a player colour; grey = any colour. Texts are our own summaries.

powers.name: Mr. Ash
powers.title: The Boss
powers.text: Start with 1 Gas Can. Every City tile counts as having Helipads. You only get 2 MP per turn.

powers.name: Pixel
powers.title: Hacker
powers.text: You may visit a closed Business without a key; each time, gain 2 Notoriety.

powers.name: Dynamo
powers.title: Explosives
powers.text: You may open Lockers without a key; gain 1 Notoriety whenever you keep a Locker tile.

powers.name: Tumbler
powers.title: Safe Expert
powers.text: When drawing Exit or Locker tiles, you may pay $2k per tile to draw 1 or 2 more to choose from.

powers.name: Wheels
powers.title: Driver
powers.text: In the Avoid step, pay $2k and return a Gas Can to avoid 1 officer of any type.

powers.name: Brick
powers.title: The Muscle
powers.text: One Item space can hold 2 Locker/Exit tiles. You can never replace tiles.

powers.name: Mole
powers.title: The Inside Man
powers.text: +$3k whenever you receive income, but everything you pay costs $1k more.

powers.name: Madame Q.
powers.title: The Fixer
powers.text: You may flip used Fixers back like Equipment, paying $1k plus the Fixer's price each time.

powers.name: Professor
powers.title: The Mastermind
powers.text: At a Safe House you may gain 1 Notoriety or lose none instead of losing 1; if you do, take a Wound.

powers.name: Viper
powers.title: Gang Member
powers.text: Start controlling the starting tile's Gang, with $3k less. You can't hire Gangs.
